rationale: `assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`. Its `description` states when to use it in terms of the user's task. It says to use it during design sessions and before changing code, tests, or requirement text in a Habeas-tracked project. It adds that this holds even when the user only asks for a feature, bug fix, CLI flag, test, dependency bump, or wording tweak. The redirections it names are optional (MAY). "Use habeas-refactor" for moving code or requirements, and "use habeas-evidence" for validation findings, both point to skills that exist under `assets/skills` (`habeas-refactor` and `habeas-evidence`). Both redirections are tied to user tasks. The requirement lists no violation queries, and I found no other gap.
